content:
10 October is the remarkable day in the history of Indian after Independence where all the patriot will come together in Delhi to protest against Tanashaa government.

I will also participate in this protest as a small support to Cockroach Janta Party and people of India and I request you all
 to take participation in the protest to save our country and constitution.

If you cannot come no worries but please support over linkedin, Instagram,Facbook ,X and Whatsapp but do support because this is for you ,for your life, for your children,for your parents and for your country.

For good hospitals,for  good schools, for good infrastructure, for good law and order , for a good life  and specially for Constitution which gives 
Equality, Fraternity and Liberty.

Jai Bhim, Jai Samvidhan, Jai Hind

Cockroach Janata Party

#India #Constitution #Democracy #Unity #Future #Liberty #Fraternity
comment: Public discussions on democracy are strongest when they also focus on civic responsibility beyond protests—such as informed voting, institutional accountability, and everyday participation in strengthening constitutional values.
